description_en: Deletes a Security Center monitoring account from the multi-account security management feature
description_zh: 删除多账号安全管理功能中的云安全中心监控账号
name: DeleteMonitorAccount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member account that you want to delete from the Security Center monitoring account list.

You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain the list of member accounts IDs that are managed by Security Center
parameters.help_zh:
云安全中心监控账号列表中待删除的成员ID。

可以调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口获取已接入云安全中心管控的成员账号ID列表
parameters.name: account_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. China Chinese Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
